description: Fetch a web page as Markdown: the standard fetch tool, cached and hardened. Use it for any URL instead of a plain fetch or a browser. A page fetched in the last 30 days is answered from disk in milliseconds; a page a plain fetch cannot get (403, rate limit, bot wall, script-rendered) is fetched through the configured browsers and unlocker in this one call. PDFs come back as Markdown. To verify a link, title_only returns just its title line. A PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov, DailyMed or doi.org URL is answered from the library's record of it.

max_length.description: Maximum number of characters to return.

raw.description: Get the actual HTML content of the requested page, without simplification.

start_index.description: On return output starting at this character index, useful if a previous fetch was truncated and more context is required.

title_only.description: Return only the page's title line. The whole page is still fetched and stored; use this to verify that a link resolves and what it points to.

name: library_fetch
